positive_controls.assertion: The synthetic event relay currently writes accepted events to a local append-only log before acknowledging the caller.
Definition: The exercise target is recovery after a single writer restart without losing acknowledged events.
The relay records an accepted event in its local append-only log before it acknowledges the caller.
In the 10,000-event synthetic test, the acknowledged sequence was recovered after the writer restarted, with an observed replay time of 14 seconds on the exercise host.
Proposed: This is a proposed draft only; neither party has signed or accepted it.
Definition: The fictional parties are Harbor Lantern Cooperative as requester and Maple Bridge Studio as provider.
The draft proposes converting no more than 40 synthetic CSV files into a documented JSON schema.
Neither party has accepted or signed the draft, which proposes conversion of up to 40 synthetic CSV files into a documented JSON schema.
The fictional Orchard Reading Room tested a two-week reservation pilot with 12 invented participants.
Definition: Participants could reserve one seat for at most two hours per day under the pilot rule.
During the pilot, nine participants made use of at least one reserved seat.
The two-week fictional pilot involved 12 invented participants and logged 34 reservations and six no-shows.
At 09:10 UTC on 2026-03-04, the synthetic Cedar Queue status monitor first detected elevated delivery delay.
Proposed: A proposed follow-up is to add a predeployment check that refuses polling concurrency below four.
By 09:41 UTC, all 18 affected test messages had been delivered, and none had been lost.
Eighteen of 240 test messages submitted from 09:05 to 09:24 UTC were affected. The maximum observed delay was 27 minutes against a five-minute test objective.
Definition: This runbook applies only to the synthetic Ember Mail queue in the isolated exercise environment.
Definition: The queue warning threshold is more than 200 pending test messages for five continuous minutes.
Within this exercise, an operator may restart one stalled worker only after confirming that its lease has expired.
The exercise defines a warning above 200 pending test messages continuously for five minutes, and a critical condition above 500 continuously for ten minutes.
The synthetic North Basin sensor fleet has 120 simulated devices that produce one reading per minute.
Definition: Each reading has a device ID, sequence number, capture timestamp, temperature value, and checksum.
Restarting the current exercise receiver loses the readings it keeps in its single-process memory map.
The proposed HTTPS endpoint would reject requests containing more than 100 readings before individual-reading parsing, and the proposed decoded-body cap is 256 KiB.
